verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows a narrow natural-language feature inside Insomnia (auto-generating mock servers from a natural-language prompt, plus AI commit-message suggestions), not natural-language operation of Kong Gateway/Admin API or Konnect itself — configuration is done via decK CLI, Admin API, or Kong Manager UI. Missing for 10: NL-driven configuration/administration of Kong Gateway, NL-based route/plugin management, evidence of broader conversational control beyond the Insomnia mock-generation feature.
